title: The Gods Begged the Strongest Man Alive — He Said No | Solo Swordmaster
hook_caption: THE GODS BEGGED HIM. HE SAID NO.
end_question: WHAT DOES HE KNOW ABOUT THE GODS THAT WE DON'T?

sentences.text: The gods themselves came down to beg one man, but he refused them to their faces.
So who was he, this retired swordsman was once the strongest man alive, the last Sword Master who saved the world.
But now he works a boring desk job for the government, the same government that seized his entire fortune and thanked him with a plaque.

beats.caption: NOW HE WORKS A DESK JOB

sentences.text: So a young agent was assigned to follow him everywhere, making sure the dangerous legend stayed quiet and harmless.

beats.caption: AN AGENT WAS SENT TO WATCH HIM

sentences.text: But one day a monster worth eighty billion went on a rampage in the middle of the city, and no hunter alive could stop it.

beats.caption: A MONSTER WENT ON A RAMPAGE

sentences.text: So the officials who robbed him suddenly begged him for help, and he only sighed and walked straight at it.
That's when, with one lazy slash, he cut the monster clean in half.
But the real shock came after the fight, when the gods who watch this world like a show appeared before him.
And they offered him a contract, the power to become their champion, the offer any man alive would kill for.

beats.caption: ANY MAN WOULD KILL FOR IT

sentences.text: But he refused them to their faces, because the last Sword Master bows to no god.
